lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice summarizing a short transport update and explaining its practical consequence.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Planning a trip after hearing a short traffic announcement.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Reporting a source, identifying cause and consequence, and choosing a backup plan.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik discuss a short traffic update about delayed trains and decide how to adjust their travel plan.

main_focus.name: cause and consequence with därför and eftersom
main_focus.description: Link a reported reason from a source to a practical consequence in the speakers' plan.
model_examples: Tåget är försenat eftersom det är ett signalfel.
Därför behöver vi ta en tidigare buss.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use cause and consequence links naturally 4-5 times in the dialogue.

allowed_supporting_grammar: future with ska and kommer att
V2 after därför and i så fall
avoid_grammar: long chains of several subordinate clauses

useful_chunks: Det beror på ett problem med trafiken.
Därför hinner vi kanske inte bytet.
I så fall tar vi bussen i stället.
vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use practical transport words and chunks that help the dialogue stay concrete.

dialogue_shape.opening: One person reports the transport update and why it matters.
dialogue_shape.middle: They connect the reason to a consequence, compare one backup option, and clarify timing.
dialogue_shape.ending: They choose the most realistic travel option.

target_complexity.repetition: cause and consequence markers should recur naturally in different positions

focus: the transport problem described in the update
the consequence for the original travel plan
which backup option is preferred and why

sentence_focus: one sentence explaining a delay with eftersom
one sentence about missing or making a connection
one sentence comparing two transport options
one sentence choosing a backup plan
